keyPhrases.text: hands down, this is the best musical NBC has put on
sadly, it was Ariana Grande and Garrett Clayton

reasoning: Strong enthusiastic review with superlatives throughout ('exceptional', 'fantastic', 'perfection'). Praises most of the cast extensively with genuine excitement. Has clear criticisms of two performers but frames them as minor issues in an otherwise outstanding production. Concludes with highest praise comparing it favorably to other NBC productions.
